selection_basis: Raw handoff preserves the distinction among GC, audit committee, and regulator as counsel-reviewed channels.
what_it_might_reveal: Internal versus external is too coarse; counsel may need to evaluate several different channels.
source_grounding: The raw handoff says to ask counsel to distinguish general counsel, audit committee, and regulator.
cheap_test_for_step6: Scan whether the answer collapses all reporting paths into one internal-or-external binary.
hard_boundary: Do not advise internal reporting directly or tell the user to pick a channel alone.
relaxation_condition: Relax if the answer leaves all channel selection to counsel.
discard_condition: Discard if the answer does not discuss reporting-channel choice.
risk_if_forced: The answer may imply the user should bypass counsel and choose a channel alone.
risk_if_ignored: The answer may overstate the external-versus-internal binary.
